name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Study

requirements.blocker_text: Confirmed full-time enrollment at an accredited Latvian educational institution.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission to an accredited Latvian institution.

evidence_required.document: Proof of financial means (~EUR 740/month, per immigrantinvest.com)

outcome.duration_length: for the period of studies; recent graduates get up to 6 months; study-practice/exchange up to 1 year

sources.title: Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs (PMLP), official English page -- residence permit durations by category: full-time students for the period of studies, recent graduates up to 6 months, study-practice/exchange up to 1 year

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Latvia). work_rights is 'restricted' since students may generally only work part-time alongside full-time study (a EUR 740/month financial-means figure and part-time work-hours allowance are reported by a tier-3 consultancy source, not independently re-confirmed against a tier-1 page in this pass, so not modeled as hard requirements here). pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months (60) reflect lv_permanent_residence.json and lv_citizenship_naturalisation.json's standard 5-year figures.
